name: Deadwood
summary: A gold-rush town frozen in the Wild West — where Wild Bill Hickok was shot holding the dead man's hand, now a National Historic Landmark of saloons and gaming halls.

lodging.name: A historic Main Street hotel
lodging.blurb: In the heart of the old town.

foodMustTry.name: A saloon steak & a sarsaparilla
foodMustTry.blurb: Old West fare on Main Street.

item.title: Historic Deadwood & Mount Moriah
item.blurb: The reenactments and saloons of Main Street, and the graves of Wild Bill and Calamity Jane up at Mount Moriah 'Boot Hill.'

commute.scenicNote: East along the edge of the Badlands to Wall.
